label: Proposal
describe: Hogbacks + 3 steel discs per side, polycarbonate hood, 16:24 belt.

label: No steel discs
describe: Lighter flywheel: drops more speed per shot, recovers just as fast.

label: 1 steel disc per side
describe: Lighter flywheel: 1 steel disc per side.

label: 2 steel discs per side
describe: Lighter flywheel: 2 steel discs per side.

label: Hood 4 mm closer to the wheel
describe: The hood's arc built 4 mm smaller: tighter pinch.

label: Hood 4 mm further from the wheel
describe: The hood's arc built 4 mm larger: looser pinch.

label: Aluminium hood
describe: Same hood shape in aluminium: different grip and bounce on the ball.

label: 24:24 belt (wheel at motor speed)
describe: Motor and wheel turn at the same speed: less torque to hold the wheel's speed.
